title: Zephyrine and the Harvest
author: Yara Iversen
blurb: Zephyrine Amberdale, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
